name: Gym Class Pass Manager
author: Asdesign Estudio Web

sections.description:
Gym Class Pass Manager gives your centre a simple booking app that members open on their phone. No plans, no payments, no complications: anyone with an account at your centre can book any class while there are spots left.

What it does

  • Activities – Yoga, Spinning, CrossFit… each with its colour, number of spots and duration.
  • Weekly schedule – the classes that repeat every week. Add the same class to several days at once.
  • Bookings – members see the next days, book a spot and cancel it before the class starts. Full classes are shown as full.
  • Members – invite them by email; they create their password and start booking. Remove access whenever you need.
  • Who is coming – the manager sees the list of members booked in each class.
  • Mobile web app – works on any phone or computer at the address you choose (for example yoursite.com/app/). Nothing to install.
  • Languages – follows your WordPress language, and each member can choose their own in the app.

There are no limits: unlimited members, activities, classes and bookings.

Gym Class Pro

Gym Class Pro is a separate, paid plugin sold only at gymclass.estudio-web.es. It is not unlocked or upgraded from this plugin: you buy it on the website, install it and activate it. It adds plans and passes, payments at reception and online (Stripe, Redsys, PayPal, WooCommerce), automatic renewals, waiting lists, cancellation rules, notifications by email, SMS, WhatsApp and push, announcements, coaches, several locations, QR access control, a community with workouts of the day, leaderboards, personal records and challenges, routines with timers, a library of over 300 exercises, reports, calendar sync, Zoom classes and your own Android and iOS app.

It uses the same data: when you activate it, this free version steps aside and you keep your activities, schedule, members and bookings. The page Gym Class Pass Manager → Gym Class Pro in your dashboard shows a full comparison with screenshots.

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external service.

Source code

The JavaScript and CSS files distributed with this plugin (in the assets/ folder) are the human-readable source. They are not minified or compiled from another private repository. No build tools are required to review or modify them.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Gym Class Pass Manager from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Go to Gym Class Pass Manager → Start and press “Open the app”. Log in with your WordPress user.
  3. In the app, create your activities (Settings → Activities) and your weekly schedule (Settings → Weekly schedule).
  4. Invite your members from Members. Give them the app address so they can save it on their phone.
sections.faq:
Can members book any class?

Yes. Anyone with an account at the centre can book any class while there are spots left, and cancel it until it starts.

The app shows “page not found”

Go to Settings → Permalinks and press “Save Changes”. If you use a cache plugin, exclude the app address.

Invitation emails do not arrive

Gym Class Pass Manager uses the normal WordPress email. If emails end up in spam or are not sent, install an SMTP plugin with an email account on your domain.

Is my data deleted if I remove the plugin?

No, unless you tick “Also delete activities, schedule and bookings” in Gym Class Pass Manager → Start before deleting it. User accounts are never deleted.

Where do I get Gym Class Pro?

Only at gymclass.estudio-web.es. It is a separate plugin: buy it there, then upload and activate it from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.

What happens if I move to Gym Class Pro?

When you activate Gym Class Pro, this free version steps aside and Pro keeps your activities, schedule, members and bookings. You can then delete the free plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Renamed plugin to Gym Class Pass Manager.
  • Fixed script loading to use wp_add_inline_script instead of a raw script tag.
  • Added contributor asdesignes and documented source location for JS/CSS.

1.0.0

  • First version: activities, weekly schedule, bookings, members with email invitations and a mobile web app with the same design as Gym Class Pro.
